blocks.text: ‘ Marcos: Govt to boost skills training for Filipino seafarers MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Wednesday said the government would strengthen efforts to equip Filipino seafarers with the skills they need to adapt to digitalization and other changes reshaping the maritime industry. He made the remark during the Philippine Maritime Convention 2026 at The Manila Hotel in Manila. “The maritime sector is in a period of profound change. Their work has become complex, and in some cases, dangerous,” the President said in his speech. “New technologies are transforming ships and ship operations.
